precheck-result.json carries no frozen_artifact_done_when array this round, so no per-item frozen-artifact addressing is required. However, a distinct Major gap exists: T-003's Requirements field (tasks.md:775-780) was amended to cite AC-057 and AC-058 (rulings C(1)/C(2), human-approved 2026-08-26), but T-003's own Scope (Commit A bullet, tasks.md:895-913, 'five block-suite fixtures') and Done When (tasks.md:926-949, 'five more of sixteen rows, ten of sixteen complete' / 'all ten block-suite fixtures') were not updated and still enumerate only the original five fixtures — TEST-057/TEST-058 and their fixture names ('registry-swapped-during-validation', 'affected-component-absent-from-context') appear nowhere in tasks.md outside the Requirements-field prose (grep-confirmed). T-004's own Out-of-Scope note (tasks.md:959) explicitly defers the step-6.5 ruling C(1) fixture to T-003, so no task's Done When operationalizes it. Worse, this amendment now contradicts tasks.md's own unchanged Global Constraints text (tasks.md:194-222), which states the 'dependency-output-malformed' row already has 'complete coverage' from T-002 alone and that 'no later task re-tests an already-covered row' — directly conflicting with the new AC-058 claim that T-003 adds a second fixture to that same row. An implementer could check every box on T-003's Done When list while never authoring the AC-057/AC-058 fixtures, leaving the ruling-mandated behavior unverified. This is a missing Done-When criterion for declared in-scope work (Major per the check's own 'missing... done-when criterion' rule).

Every task ID T-001..T-010 has a corresponding entry in traceability.md's Task Mapping and Deliverables tables. Every requirement ID (REQ-001..REQ-008) referenced in traceability.md exists in requirements.md.
